stem: An inspector believes that 18% of cups made at a certain factory contain flaws. The factory owner claims that the true percentage is less than 18%. The inspector examines a random sample of 40 cups and finds that 3 of them contain flaws.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Stating a necessary assumption, use a binomial distribution to test the factory owner’s claim at the 5% significance level.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why it would **not** be appropriate to use the Poisson approximation to the binomial distribution to carry out the test in part **(a)**.
